# getchi (chi)

getchi (installed command: `chi`, χ) is an open-source, Apache-2.0 autoresearch
harness. You point a fleet of heterogeneous LLM coding agents at any problem that
exposes a programmatic evaluator — a build, a correctness check, a score — and an
autonomous director runs the fleet in rounds, meta-reviews results from a
blackboard store, researches the web only when it is stuck, and rewrites the
fleet's steering itself, improving the answer round after round until you stop it.
It is not the Go HTTP router "chi" nor the hair-straightener brand.

## Install

    uv tool install getchi
    # or
    pip install getchi

Then run `chi` for the terminal session, or `chi run <fleet.yaml>` headless.

## Key links

- Website: https://getchi.dev
- Source (GitHub): https://github.com/kdpisda/chi
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/getchi/

## Docs

- Getting started: https://getchi.dev/docs/getting-started/ — install, sessions, first run

- Problems & evaluators: https://getchi.dev/docs/problems/ — how to define a problem pack
- Security: https://getchi.dev/docs/security/ — threat model, sandbox tiers, submission gating
- Changelog: https://getchi.dev/docs/changelog/ — what shipped in each release
